author: _DISTRACTION_
body:
Hello,

Since the first part of the Avicus Summer Update has been completed, the map development team would like to explain what has been done so far, and what the plans are for the rest of the update.

The first part of the Summer Update was focused on general maintenance of the rotations introduced in the Renaissance Update. Here is what was done to each server:

Destroy: Poorly-playing maps were removed, and some older DTM maps were added to the rotation.

Capture: Maps with low ratings were removed, and some newer CTW maps were added.

Walls: Three more of Avicus’ old Walls maps were added to the rotation.

Conquest: No changes.

The second (upcoming) part of the update will be focused on the community, in two ways. Firstly, we will be loading and testing maps that have been accepted on the forums, and additional maps that have been made by the builder team. We will test maps’ gameplay on public servers; if you have any feedback on a map that is tested, feel free to post it on the forum thread of that map, or in #map-making in the Avicus Discord.

Secondly, most of the changes to the rotations in the second part of this update will be based on community feedback that has been received. The general points of what will be happening are:

Destroy:
-The rotation will be longer.
-More regular DTM maps will be added, and there will be less of a focus on DTC and TNT maps in general. We aren’t abandoning those two gamemodes; the rotation will simply have a higher proportion of normal DTM maps.
-Some of the better-playing old Avicus maps will be added. (A few have already been added in Part 1 of the update.)

Capture:
-The rotation will be longer.
-Map gameplay will be monitored and certain maps may be edited in order to improve their gameplay.
-The rotation will have a higher proportion of normal two-team CTW maps, and less 4-team CTW maps.
-The amount of Ender CTW maps in the rotation may be slightly increased. (However, Ender Hill will most likely not return in this update.)

Walls:
-The rotation will be longer.
-Some of the old Walls kits may be added, and some of the current ones may be edited.

Conquest:
-The rotation will be longer.
-We will most likely add more TDM maps, but we will be more focused on adding new KoTH maps.

To provide rotation feedback, please continue using these threads:

Destroy Server Feedback: https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/e9ac2fb88
Capture Server Feedback: https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/c3b677672
Walls Server Feedback: https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/b9d52ca63
Conquest Server Feedback: https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/75a6d98b2

In order to keep the threads clean and concise, please do not repeat exact suggestions that have already been made. It is fine to discuss previous suggestions, but having multiple people saying the exact same thing would serve no purpose. It is up to you to know what has already been suggested; we reserve the right to archive any posts that violate the request made in this paragraph.

If you have any questions, please ask.

Thank you.
